free_tier.stated: $5.00/mo base subscription includes 250 GiB across all buckets; +$0.02/GiB beyond

egress.terms: 1,024 GiB/month outbound included and shared across buckets, then $0.01/GiB (= $10.24/TB). Free only between Spaces and Droplets in the same metro.

chaining: Built-in CDN is the mitigation: serve through Spaces CDN so origin egress does not accrue.
limits_note: The 250 GiB included storage is trivial; the $0.02/GiB marginal rate makes this ~$20/TB, i.e. 4.5x Datalix. Bandwidth allowance is per account, not per bucket.
reliability_note: Mature and reliable; simply not competitively priced above a few hundred GB.

evidence.proved: "base price of a Spaces Standard Storage subscription is $5.00 per month", "includes 250 GiB of storage", "Additional storage beyond this allotment costs $0.02 per GiB per month", "include 1,024 GiB of outbound data transfer... Additional outbound transfer is $0.01 per GiB"
accepted payment methods incl. Visa/Mastercard/Amex/Discover/PayPal/Google Pay/Apple Pay

price_per_tb_month: $20.48/TB at 5 TB ($102.40) and $20.48/TB at 20 TB ($409.60), plus $10.24/TB on egress beyond 1 TiB.
